status: exploration on the development folds (user decision 26.09.2026, relayed by Head DS); not a pre-registration: a final check needs its own
interpretation: registered loss of connection ('Неисправен', organizer: loss of connection with the device); not a confirmed breakdown; alarm is not a confirmed failure
fold_note: as v5: embargo = horizon; calibration and holdout are not read
fit_rows: as v5: candidate rows with a known 168 h label, all positives plus the deterministic 10% hash sample of negatives; rows ordered by (channel_id, issued_at)

evaluation.policy: rolling list with release, at most K open, window 7 days
evaluation.scores: static list, persistence, rank mean of list and persistence, F2 per seed (mean and spread), F2+sel, rank mean of F2 and the list per seed, ceiling
evaluation.bootstrap: paired week and object blocks, 400 replicates, seed 17, against the static list
evaluation.lead: median lead of captured events (event start minus first capturing issue), model minus list, week-block bootstrap; technologist criterion K2: does the model know the timing

grid.scores: rules everywhere; models where saved scores exist (7, 10, 14 days)
grid.best_point: per horizon, the point nearest to P >= 0.7 and R >= 0.5 by the worse of the two folds
